name: Magic Ruby
body:
The magic you learn enhances the natural magic in your horn as your ruby grows.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast spells, magic horn racial trait, Almiraj

Benefit(s): The enhancement bonus of your magic horn is equal to 1 + 1/2 the level of the highest level spell you can cast (rounded down). Your horn cannot exceed a +5 enhancement bonus.

Normal: Your magic horn has a +1 enhancement.

Example: If you could cast 9th level spells your magic horn would have a +5 enhancement. (9/2 = 4.5, rounded down to 4, +1 = 5).
